title: O Little Town of Bethlehem
commons_title: File:O Little Town of Bethlehem - Singing Sergeants - United States Air Force Band.mp3
composition: words by Phillips Brooks (1868), music by Lewis Redner (1868); both public domain
credit: Arrangement by Robert Thurston; performance by the United States Air Force Band (a work of the US Government, public domain).
lyrics: How still we see thee lie
Above thy deep and dreamless sleep
Yet in thy dark streets shineth
The hopes and fears of all the years
